verdict.rationale: Granola's docs say notes are private by default and are never shared unless the user copies a link or adds the note to a team-space folder. The sidebar separates a private 'My notes' space from a workspace team space whose folders are visible to everyone in the workspace. That covers private-by-default and coarse link/folder sharing, but the evidence shows no granular permission levels and no admin controls. Missing for 10: granular link permissions (view/edit, domain restriction, expiry), per-folder access controls beyond workspace-wide visibility, admin visibility or audit of what's shared, admin policy to restrict sharing.
